launch.meta.title: Launch identity, lintcha
launch.meta.description: What a launch on Robinhood Chain calls itself, and what those strings are shared with: ticker, name, links, logo, fee recipient and description against one day of launches. Strings only, in your browser.
launch.intro: Paste the fields as the launch shows them. The page compares the strings with every launch of one day and says what is shared, with how many, and since when. It reads strings, not the contract, and it never resolves an address.
launch.privacy: What you paste stays in your browser. The table it is compared with is fetched once from this domain on the first check, so a first visit needs the network; nothing else is loaded and nothing leaves the page.
launch.window: Window: {from_date} to {to_date} UTC, blocks {from_block} to {to_block}, {launches} launches, collected {collected}.
launch.form.name: Name
launch.form.recipient: Creator fee recipient, the address as text
launch.form.hint: Fields as the launch shows them, empty where the launch left them empty. Nothing is fetched or resolved from what you type; an address is compared as text.
launch.group.name: What it calls itself
launch.row.shared_one: {n} launches in the window carry it, all from one deployer.
launch.row.shared_many: {n} launches in the window carry it, from {d} different deployers.
launch.row.lookalike: {n} launches in the window use a ticker that folds to this shape, across {v} different spellings, from {d} deployers.
launch.row.lookalike_name: {n} launches in the window use a name that folds to this shape, across {v} different spellings, from {d} deployers.
launch.row.unique: No other launch in the window carries it.
launch.state.fetching: Fetching the table from this domain.
launch.state.fetch_failed: The table could not be fetched from this domain, so nothing was compared. With the network off, this section cannot run on a first visit.
launch.state.no_digest: This browser context cannot hash the strings, so nothing was compared. Open the page over https.
launch.fixed.p1: This reads strings, not the contract. It compares what a launch wrote about itself with what other launches wrote, nothing more.
launch.fixed.p2: A shared value is not proof of anything. Projects relaunch, teams share a channel, and copying a link takes a second. The page says what is shared, with how many, and since when, and stops there.
launch.fixed.p3: The window is one day, {from_date} to {to_date}, its block range stated above. Absence from it means no other launch in that day carries the value. A count never says whether one of the launches counted is the one being pasted, because the page cannot tell.
launch.fixed.p4: Nothing here is a view on whether to enter, exit or size anything.
